/* PlatformCustomerMapper.selectCustomerList */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.CMPNY_NM AS cmpnyNm , A.BSNS_LCN_NO AS bsnsLcnNo , A.ADDR_1 AS addr1 , A.ADDR_2 AS addr2 , A.ZIP_CODE AS zipCode , A.CONTRACT_YN AS contractYn , A.CONTRACT_END_DATE AS contractEndDate , A.USE_YN AS useYn , IFNULL(U.INPUT_TOKENS + U.OUTPUT_TOKENS, 0) AS usedTokens , IFNULL(Q.MONTHLY_TOKEN_LIMIT, 800000) AS tokenLimit , CASE WHEN Q.CMPNY_CD IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS quotaCustomYn FROM TB_CMPNY A LEFT JOIN TB_AI_TOKEN_QUOTA Q ON Q.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD LEFT JOIN TB_AI_TOKEN_USAGE U ON U.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND U.USE_YM = #{useYm}
ORDER BY A.CMPNY_CD ASC LIMIT 500
